_instructions: Spec template for `kappmaker create-mascot --spec <file>` — stage 1, the 4×4 grid of 16 DIFFERENT mascot concepts the user picks from.

This is a proven BASELINE, not a rigid schema: add fields, restructure, or write a richer spec if it produces better mascots. ONE mechanical constraint is fixed: the output MUST stay a single 4×4 grid of 16 mascot concepts with uniform margins — the CLI slices it into cells afterwards.
Fill app_idea and app_tone from AiGuidelines/ (brand color, audience, vibe). Customize concept_directions to steer the 16 cells; leave entries generic to let the model explore.
Backgrounds must stay white or transparent (background removal runs afterwards), and the image must contain NO text of any kind.

grid_layout.arrangement: A single high-resolution image: 4×4 grid, one unique mascot CONCEPT per cell, consistent size and perspective across cells, uniform margins/padding so each cell can be cleanly split later, clear separation between squares.
grid_layout.background: white or transparent — emphasizes the mascot designs, supports background removal

character_rules: Each cell is a DIFFERENT character concept — distinct appearance, coloring, shape or style
All mascots playful, cute, or gamified — suitable for an ultra-cute app style
Each mascot occupies roughly the same amount of space in its cell
If brand_colors are given, weave them into some mascots while keeping variety
No clutter, distortion, or blurriness — every mascot clearly stands out
constraints: NO TEXT WHATSOEVER: no words, letters, numbers, icons with text meaning, UI elements, speech bubbles, emojis, watermarks or logos
